min.$description: 44px. Minimum touch target for any interactive control (mobile-first floor).

floor.$description: 24px. Absolute WCAG 2.5.8 target-size floor, only for a documented exception.

width.$description: 2px. Thickness of the focus indicator edge, matching the indigo edge of shadow.focus (WCAG 2.4.13 area).

offset.$description: 2px. Gap between the control and the focus indicator edge, matching the white gap of shadow.focus.

text-min.$description: 16px. Minimum font size of any text-entry control, so iOS Safari does not zoom on focus.

margin.$description: Scroll margin for scrollIntoView of an active or focused item, so sticky or fixed bars never obscure it (WCAG 2.4.11).

hairline.$description: The one documented raw 1px hairline. Dividers and input outlines; never for focus or emphasis.
